summary: gsd-2 is archived (README.md is only a redirect to open-gsd/gsd-pi), but its user docs (mirrored in gitbook/ and mintlify-docs/) repeat headline savings figures (40-60% token reduction from token profiles, 20-50% from dynamic model routing, 30-50% from compact notation) with no method, data or quality measurement. The closest evidence is a synthetic-fixture integration test that asserts at least 30% character savings for DB-scoped prompts, and an RTK token-savings script (scripts/rtk-benchmark.mjs); neither has committed outputs and neither tests the headline figures. The ADR-003 token figures are design-time estimates, and the docs themselves say routing capability profiles are 'heuristic rankings, not benchmarks'.
result_focus_note: manual classification of published_results: outcome = does the tool do its job; engineering = speed of the software itself
